title: chore(ts-migration): hits widget, connector and stories
body:
This pull request adds the migration to typescript of Hits connector, widget and stories.

Note that, you may find some adjustments on the type system of my previous pull request about hits per page.

Also, this pull request can not be merged without migrating the current connectors, widgets to the type system changes.

comments.body: Closing this pull request in favour of refactoring internals first, in a side pull request.
